skill.name: algorithmic-art
skill.description: Guide AI tools to create original p5.js generative art with seeded randomness, interactive parameters, and reusable HTML viewers.
skill.summary: Creates original seeded p5.js generative art with interactive controls and repeatable variations.

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or actual command execution was found. Most static execution and reconnaissance hits are Markdown, comments, CSS, or RegExp.exec false positives. The confirmed issues are low-risk external CDN and font dependencies in the generated HTML templates.

remediation.issue: Generated HTML depends on a remote p5.js CDN script.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle p5.js locally, or pin the remote script with integrity and crossorigin attributes.

remediation.issue: The viewer template loads Google Fonts from third-party domains.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle needed fonts or use local fallback fonts for offline and privacy-sensitive use.

content.value_statement: Creative teams need repeatable generative art without starting from a blank canvas. This skill turns a visual idea into a seeded p5.js artwork with controls and an HTML viewer.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy for a requested visual theme.
Builds p5.js sketches with deterministic seed controls.
Uses a provided HTML viewer template with sidebar controls.
Adds sliders, color pickers, reset controls, and download actions.
Explains parameters that affect the generative system.
limitations: Generated artifacts rely on external p5.js and font CDNs unless modified.
The skill guides creation, but it does not render images by itself.
Complex animations may need performance tuning in the target browser.
It avoids copying named artists or protected visual styles.

use_cases.description: Turn a visual direction into adjustable systems for review and iteration.

use_cases.description: Show how seeds, noise, particles, and parameters shape generative systems.

prompt_templates.title: Design parameter exploration
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on controls and variations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a seeded p5.js viewer for organic turbulence. Add controls for density, field strength, speed, and palette intensity.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a polished artifact
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete browser-ready viewer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a gallery-ready generative artwork about controlled chaos. Include the philosophy, responsive controls, seed navigation, and a PNG download action.

output_examples.input: A meditative artwork inspired by ocean currents.
output_examples.output: A movement philosophy, an interactive p5.js viewer, seed navigation, and sliders for flow strength, density, and color drift.

output_examples.input: Create 100 variations of a geometric bloom system.
output_examples.output: A seeded viewer where each seed changes the composition while keeping controls and download actions consistent.

output_examples.input: Teach how noise fields affect particle motion.
output_examples.output: A browser-ready teaching artifact with labeled controls for noise scale, particle count, trail length, and speed.

best_practices: Start from a clear aesthetic goal and let parameters support that goal.
Keep seeds visible so users can reproduce favorite outputs.
Test the generated HTML in a browser before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not copy a protected style from a living artist.
Do not remove seed controls from the viewer template.
Do not add unreviewed scripts or trackers to generated artifacts.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates original p5.js generative art with seeded variation and interactive controls.

faq.question: Does it produce finished image files directly?
faq.answer: No. It produces an HTML viewer that can render and download artwork in a browser.

faq.question: Can users reproduce the same artwork?
faq.answer: Yes. The seed controls make the same settings produce the same visual output.

faq.question: Does the viewer work offline?
faq.answer: Not by default. The template loads p5.js and fonts from external CDNs.

faq.question: Can it copy a specific artist style?
faq.answer: No. The skill asks for original algorithmic art and avoids protected styles.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
